title: docs(skills): objectstack-data evals 11, 12 and 14 spell their own must_contain literals
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1y7LCQ5BQ2d99iiA1uYtoX)_

Fixes #33404

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kosBSSwdHAtnroZRx

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 的 `objects-fields-relationships.json` 里第 11、12、14 例的参考答案(`expected_output`)改为写出它们自己 `must_contain` 要求的字面拼写:`type: 'select'`、`type: 'state_machine'`、`type: 'summary'`、`type: 'formula'`、`label: '公司名称'`、`value: 'active'`。断言本身一字未动。
- 为什么改:这三例的参考答案只用散文描述这些类型和标签,用自己的评分器去判会失败,所以这三例分不出对的回答和错的回答。六个字面拼写都是 `main` 上 data 技能教的写法,错的是参考答案,不是断言。
- 风险与回滚:只动 eval 夹具(测量、不计入棘轮)与一个 changeset,不动 SKILL.md、schema 或运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 第 192、211、246 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,预期只见三行 `expected_output` 把散文换成带引号的字面拼写;对整份文件逐例检查,每个 `must_contain` 都出现在 `expected_output` 里,没有任何 `must_not_contain` 出现。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, three `expected_output` strings. No `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` entry, prompt or id changes.

- **Eval 11** (order lifecycle): "a `status` `select`" becomes "a `status` field of `type: 'select'`"; "a `state_machine` validation" becomes "a `type: 'state_machine'` validation".
- **Eval 12** (project task counts): "are `summary` fields" becomes "are `type: 'summary'` fields"; "`completion_rate` is a `formula`" becomes "`completion_rate` is a `type: 'formula'` field".
- **Eval 14** (supplier object): "(`公司名称`, `联系邮箱`, `合作状态`; options `active` → `合作中`, `terminated` → `已终止`)" becomes "(`label: '公司名称'`, `label: '联系邮箱'`, `label: '合作状态'`; options `{ label: '合作中', value: 'active' }`, `{ label: '已终止', value: 'terminated' }`)". The two sibling labels and the second option are spelled the same way so the sentence stays one shape.
- **`.changeset/33404-skills-data-evals-own-literals.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (the evals ship in the package's `dist/skills`), with both declaration lines.

## Why

Per literal, which side is wrong against `main` (order ruling: say which). In every case the literal is right and the `expected_output` is wrong: it named the type or label in prose, so the reference answer failed its own grader.

| Eval | Literal | Taught on `main` at | Wrong side |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | `type: 'select'` | `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md:73`, `:80` | `expected_output` |
| 11 | `type: 'state_machine'` | `rules/validation.md:110`, `references/examples-objects.md:94` | `expected_output` |
| 12 | `type: 'summary'` | `rules/relationships.md:47`, `:188` | `expected_output` |
| 12 | `type: 'formula'` | `rules/field-types.md:217` | `expected_output` |
| 14 | `label: '公司名称'` | the eval's own rule: labels follow the request's language (`label: '供应商'` already in the same answer) | `expected_output` |
| 14 | `value: 'active'` | `rules/field-types.md:80-86` (every option has a lowercase `value` and a `label`, written `{ label, value }`) | `expected_output` |

The other literals of these evals (`initialStates: ['draft']`, `transitions`, `function: 'count'`, `filter: { status: 'completed' }`, `label: '供应商'`, `sharingModel`) were already present and are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Order mechanism assumption 2 does not hold as worded.** `skills/objectstack-data/evals/README.md` does not state that every `must_contain` literal must appear in `expected_output`; it says `expected_output` is "what a correct answer does (and avoids)" and the assertions are "string checks used to score the output". The rule is the card's (a reference answer should pass its own grader), and every other eval in the file already follows it. Not changed here: a README sentence was not in the order's surface.
- **The same shape check over every `skills/*/evals/*.json` on `main` 4bba8b8f** (measure only, not fixed here, per the order). After this PR the data bundle is clean (every `must_contain` literal in `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` literal in it). Other misses:
  - `objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` eval 20: `type: 'subflow'`.
  - `objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` eval 2: `dialect: 'cel'`.
  - `objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` eval 2: `keyset`.
  - `objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` eval 1: `dataset`.
  - `objectui/evals/*.json`: 17 evals across 8 files miss one or more tokens. objectui's `expected_output` is written as a short prose summary throughout, and its own gate (`ui` `check:skill-eval-tokens`) checks that each token is taught by the skill, not that it is in `expected_output`, so these read as that bundle's convention rather than drift.
- **Shape check.** A check that each `must_contain` literal appears in its `expected_output` would have stopped this drift and is about 15 lines over the existing JSON. Not added (the order rules no gate; the four-axis framework defaults new gates to no). Raised for the seat to decide whether a card is worth filing.

## Verification

Head `7a68c599`, base `origin/main` 4bba8b8f.

<details><summary>Shape check before and after</summary>

One-off script over `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json` (each eval: `must_contain` literals missing from `expected_output`; `must_not_contain` literals present in it).

- Before (origin/main 4bba8b8f): eval 11 `["type: 'select'","type: 'state_machine'"]`, eval 12 `["type: 'summary'","type: 'formula'"]`, eval 14 `["label: '公司名称'","value: 'active'"]`. No other miss in either data file.
- After (7a68c599): no miss in either data file; no `must_not_contain` hit in `objects-fields-relationships.json`. The file still parses as JSON.

</details>

<details><summary>Line and token budget (skills/**)</summary>

- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`: 332 to 332 lines, 20684 to 20792 bytes, 5171 to 5198 tokens (eval fixture: measured, not ratcheted).
- Whole package, all `skills/*/SKILL.md`: 4597 to 4597 lines (no SKILL.md touched).
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0 ("57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) and 29 eval fixture(s) measured, not ratcheted").

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 41 derived, 39 green, 2 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 41 families for the two paths. Each ran on 7a68c599 with its exit code captured before any pipe, after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` (and their closure) under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0, 79s):

- 39 exit 0, among them `check-adr-0087-registration` (scan and `--self-test`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` (scan and `--self-test`), `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:published-files`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-links`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` (each over the 5 built packages only).
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (each reads every package's `dist/`): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. No package source is touched; CI builds and runs them.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "41 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 39 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

</details>

<details><summary>Tier and governed readings</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY `claude-fable-5-2` (`skills/**`, clause ①, the published catalog; no one-line exit for this surface). This change was authored on the session's configured model, `claude-opus-5-5`; the at-tier review is the seat's.
